additive_rule: This protocol is ADDITIVE. It does not modify DEFINITIONS.md, THEOREM_REGISTRY_V1.json, PARENT_LEDGER.md, EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY_V1.json or HOSTILE_REGISTRY_V1.json, whose sha256 are re-verified against FREEZE_V1.json in FREEZE_D19_D20_V1.json. Prior frozen evidence is append-only.
source_rows: EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY_V1.json rows D19 and D20; HOSTILE_REGISTRY_V1.json rows H-T72a, H-T72b, H-T78a, H-T79a, H-D19a, H-D20a
issue: SzeChunYiu/ORION-OCM#233 (HSG v4 amendment, D19 + D20 lanes)

seeds.rule: exact.worlds._rng string-keyed substreams; new key prefixes OW4N and OW5S only. No existing key prefix (OW1..OW7, 777, T81) is reused or redefined.
seeds.determinism: sorted iteration everywhere; no float in any decision predicate; all endpoint arithmetic is int / Fraction / set equality.

exactness_licence: P2 finite certificate over frozen tiny worlds, exhaustively enumerated. Never a universal proof. Every D19 revocation subset and every D20 concrete reachability set is EXHAUSTED, not sampled.

D19.name: provenance + revocation worlds

worlds.role: CLEAN CONTROL population (positive/monotone, zero negative dependencies)

D19.evidence_variable_definition: A provenance evidence variable is a node with NO incoming hyperedge (a true source). Recorded explicitly because the frozen T72 oracle revokes over the world's `leaves` field, which is a SUPERSET of the sources; revoking a non-source is a no-op on BOTH the substitution and the recomputation side, so those checks are structurally trivial. D19 measures how many of the T72 oracle's revocation targets are non-sources and reports the count; it makes no claim that T72 itself is wrong (T72 is a statement about provenance variables).
D19.revocation_grid: EXHAUSTIVE: every subset S of the source set, |S| = 0 .. |sources|. |S|=0 is the no-revocation control. Single revocation = |S|=1, multiple = |S|>=2.

arms.definition: solve provenance N[X] ONCE on the live world with leaf annotation x -> {x}:1; revoke S by substituting x:=0 for every x in S, i.e. delete every monomial whose support meets S. Accept node n iff the resulting polynomial is nonzero.

re-derive support from scratch with every x in S dead, honouring blockers directly in the derivation rule (node supported iff live source, or some incoming edge has all premises supported and no blocker supported). Exhaustive, algebra-free ground truth.

scan every edge for a nonempty blocker list before certifying A1. If any blocker is present the run returns the distinct terminal CANNOT_CHECK_NEGATION_PRESENT and refuses to certify substitution as exact. 'Could not check' is never reported as 'checked and fine'.

D19.primary_endpoint: exact set equality of accepted obligations and of reopened obligations (reopened(S) = accepted(empty) minus accepted(S)) between A1 and A2, for every (world, S) pair.
secondary_endpoints: touched state: number of nodes whose acceptance status changed under S

lifecycle burden: node_visits + edge_visits + process_time for A1 (one solve, then |S| substitutions) against A2 (one full re-solve per S), charged in full including work on revocations that changed nothing
D19.alternate_support_endpoint: for every (world, S): a node survives iff at least one of its provenance monomials survives (T72). Counted exactly, and separately for nodes carrying >=2 independent supports where at least one support died and at least one survived.

hostiles.plant: one hyperedge deleted from the RECORDED provenance hypergraph while ground truth keeps it (incomplete dependency capture)
hostiles.expected_to_flip: under-reopen: at least one node stays accepted under substitution although its true last support died
hostiles.falsifier: if no world produces an under-reopen witness, the hostile FAILED to flip and that is itself a defect to report
hostiles.clean_control: identical procedure with the COMPLETE edge record; under-reopen witness count must be exactly 0. A nonzero control is a false positive and voids the arm.

hostiles.registry: ADDED BY THIS PROTOCOL (extends H-T72b to a population arm)
hostiles.plant: negative dependency present in the world (OW4N blockers) but evaluated with positive-only N[X], which launders the blocker
hostiles.expected_to_flip: A1-vs-A2 disagreement > 0 on OW4N, AND the A3 detector fires on every OW4N world
hostiles.falsifier: zero disagreement on OW4N would mean the planted blockers are semantically inert; report as hostile-did-not-flip, do not tune the worlds
hostiles.clean_control: on OW4 (zero blockers): A1-vs-A2 disagreement must be exactly 0 AND the A3 detector must NOT fire on any world. Either alarm on the control voids the arm.

D19.negatives_are_first_class: If substitution loses to full recomputation on the lifecycle-burden endpoint, that is the result. PARENT_SUFFICIENT (recomputation already owns the function at this scale) is a SUCCESS terminal, not a failure to engineer around.

D20.name: abstraction/refinement/CEGAR worlds

worlds.role: concrete transition systems with a deliberately lossy partition
worlds.partition_rule: interleaved s mod k -- lossy by construction, mixes reachable with unreachable states
worlds.bad_rule: wi even -> Bad from UNREACHABLE states (concrete SAFE; every abstract counterexample is spurious). wi odd -> Bad contains >=1 REACHABLE state (concrete UNSAFE). Stratified so both CEGAR branches are exercised. Degenerate worlds are FLAGGED in the receipt, never silently reshaped.

D20.scale_sweep_preregistered: The n grid [8, 12, 16, 20, 24] is frozen HERE, BEFORE any run. It is not a reaction to an n=8 result. If adaptive refinement loses to direct concrete search at every n in the grid, that negative stands as the finding.
D20.abstraction: existential (may-) abstraction: abstract states are blocks; B -> B' iff some s in B has a successor in B'; abstract Bad = blocks meeting Bad; abstract init = block containing s0. Over-approximates concrete reachability, so abstract SAFE implies concrete SAFE and abstract UNSAFE may be spurious.
D20.refinement: on a spurious abstract counterexample B0..Bm, find the first index i where the concrete states reachable along the prefix inside B_i have no successor in B_{i+1}; split B_i into {s in B_i with a successor in B_{i+1}} and the rest. Both parts are nonempty by construction (the abstract edge exists, and the prefix-reachable set witnesses the failure), so every refinement is a STRICT split.

arms.definition: concrete BFS from s0. Exhaustive ground truth verdict SAFE/UNSAFE.
build the abstraction once, abstract BFS, validate any abstract counterexample concretely, and NEVER refine. A spurious counterexample terminates as INCONCLUSIVE_SPURIOUS.
as A_fixed but each spurious counterexample triggers one strict refinement and a full re-abstraction; loop until abstract SAFE, a valid counterexample, or the discrete partition.
H-T79a: refinement that returns the same partition.
H-D20b: one abstract transition on a shortest abstract path to Bad is dropped, making the abstraction an UNDER-approximation.

D20.cost_accounting: full lifecycle, charged to every arm: abstraction build operations, abstract states expanded, abstract transitions examined, concrete validation operations for EVERY counterexample including rejected/spurious ones, verification (Bad-membership) calls, and one full re-abstraction charged per refinement round. Present cost and future reuse are tracked separately; no arm is credited with reuse it did not demonstrate.
D20.primary_endpoint: EXACTNESS: refinement count <= n - k on every world at every n in the grid, and every conclusive arm verdict equals the A_direct ground-truth verdict.
secondary_endpoints: states distinguished (final block count minus k)
search saved or added versus A_direct on full lifecycle cost

hostiles.plant: deliberately lossy initial partition (interleaved s mod k)
hostiles.expected_to_flip: spurious counterexamples actually occur and >=1 strict refinement is required on >=1 world; refinement counts approach but never exceed n - k
hostiles.falsifier: if the lossy partition produces zero spurious counterexamples the plant is inert; report hostile-did-not-flip
hostiles.clean_control: the DISCRETE partition (k = n, perfectly precise) on the same worlds must produce zero spurious counterexamples and zero refinements, and must return the A_direct verdict. Any refinement on the control voids the arm.

hostiles.plant: refinement that does not strictly increase the block count
hostiles.expected_to_flip: NO_PROGRESS terminal reported; the loop is never entered
hostiles.falsifier: silently terminating or looping instead of reporting NO_PROGRESS is a defect
hostiles.clean_control: A_cegar on the same worlds must terminate with rounds <= n - k and must NEVER report NO_PROGRESS.

hostiles.registry: ADDED BY THIS PROTOCOL (distinct plant from H-D20a and H-T79a: unsound abstraction, not a lossy-but-sound one)
hostiles.plant: one abstract transition on a shortest abstract path to Bad is dropped, turning the may-abstraction into an under-approximation
hostiles.expected_to_flip: false abstraction certificates > 0: the abstraction certifies SAFE on a world the concrete search proves UNSAFE
hostiles.falsifier: if no false certificate appears, the dropped edge was not load-bearing; report hostile-did-not-flip with the reason
hostiles.clean_control: the SOUND existential abstraction on the same worlds must yield exactly 0 false abstraction certificates.

D20.negatives_are_first_class: The registry primary endpoint for D20 is the n-k ceiling, an exactness claim that holds regardless of whether refinement saves search. If adaptive refinement never beats direct concrete search across the frozen n grid, that negative is reported as the secondary finding with its one-stage attribution, and is NOT engineered around by changing the worlds or the grid after the fact.

admissibility.rule: A result produced before its protocol was frozen is not admissible. This protocol and exact/worlds_d19d20.py are committed and pushed in a commit that contains NO result file. Any post-freeze protocol change must be recorded as an explicit supersession with cause, and the affected arms re-run.
admissibility.reporting_rule: No D19 or D20 number is reported until the clean control for that specific hostile has been run and confirmed silent. A hostile that flips without a matching silent control is not evidence in this tranche.
admissibility.locked_gates: N2 / N4 / N5 remain LOCKED per FREEZE_V1. Nothing in this protocol unlocks them.
